en_title: Shrek 2 Remastered Reveal Trailer Parodies GTA 6, Sets November Release Date
subtitle: 史瑞克不避战
opus_summary: Aspyr公布《怪物史瑞克2》重制版，11月10日登陆XBOX Series，现已开放预购。预告恶搞《GTA6》的罪恶都市风格与系列封面，两作发售仅隔九天。

paragraphs.en: Shrek 2 Remastered is real, and its release date is less than a month away.
paragraphs.cn: 《怪物史瑞克2》重制版确实来了，而且距离发售已不到一个月。

paragraphs.en: As revealed during today's ID@Xbox showcase for October 2026, Aspyr Media has recreated a cult classic tie-in game from the original Xbox era for 2026. Shrek 2 Remastered is a modern version of Activision's co-op video game that will allow players to relive swampy memories when it comes to Xbox Series X/S next month, November 10.
paragraphs.cn: 在今天举行的2026年10月ID@XBOX展示会上，Aspyr Media公布了为2026年重制的一款初代XBOX时代电影改编游戏。原作虽小众，却拥有一批忠实拥趸。《怪物史瑞克2》重制版为Activision当年的合作游戏带来了现代化升级，将于下个月，也就是11月10日登陆XBOX Series，让玩家重温沼泽中的回忆。

paragraphs.en: The reveal trailer offers a sneak peek at how fan-favorite playable characters and classic moments from DreamWorks' fairytale sequel have been upgraded with improved graphics, new features, and more. It's been a while since players were able to play as Shrek, Fiona, Donkey, Gingy, and more, but you can get a taste of some of what's in store in the footage below.
paragraphs.cn: 公布预告让玩家抢先看到了画面改进、新功能等升级：梦工厂这部童话续作中深受喜爱的可玩角色和经典场景，都将以新面貌呈现。距离玩家上次操控史瑞克、菲奥娜、驴子、姜饼人等角色，已经过去了很久，不过下方的视频能让你提前一睹这次的部分内容。

paragraphs.en: You may have noticed that the opening isn't something from the original Shrek 2. Aspyr took today's announcement trailer as an opportunity to acknowledge the elephant in the room: That its November release date puts it within spitting distance of Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6 . Set for release just nine days later, November 19, GTA 6 seems to have convinced most other games to steer clear of its launch window – but not Shrek.
paragraphs.cn: 你可能已经注意到，预告开场并非出自原版《怪物史瑞克2》。Aspyr借今天的公布预告，正面回应了一个无法回避的问题：游戏定于11月发售，与Rockstar的《GTA6》几乎撞期。《GTA6》将于仅仅九天后的11月19日发售，似乎已经让大多数其他游戏选择避开它的发售档期——但史瑞克不打算这么做。

paragraphs.en: Instead of shooting for a different date, Shrek 2 Remastered is sticking to its November 10 plan. The trailer takes a tongue-in-cheek jab at Rockstar's latest, going as far as to not only recreate its Vice City vibe but even come up with its own version of that iconic Grand Theft Auto box art, too.
paragraphs.cn: 《怪物史瑞克2》重制版没有另选日期，而是坚持11月10日发售的计划。预告还幽默地调侃了Rockstar这部新作，不仅再现了罪恶都市的氛围，甚至还仿照《侠盗猎车手》系列标志性的封面，设计了自己的版本。

paragraphs.en: The original Shrek 2 video game , meanwhile, launched in 2004 and came to the GameCube, PlayStation 2, and original Xbox. While we wait for the remaster to launch in just a few short weeks, you can check out a summary for the original experience below:
paragraphs.cn: 原版《怪物史瑞克2》游戏于2004年发售，登陆了GameCube、PlayStation 2和初代XBOX。距离重制版发售只剩短短几周，等待期间，不妨先看看下面这段原作介绍：

paragraphs.en: "Go beyond the film as you guide Shrek and all his pals on a thrilling, squad-based action-adventure for four players. Voyage through familiar haunts like Shrek's swamp. Tag-team baddies and use each character's special abilities to solve puzzles and accomplish mission objectives."
paragraphs.cn: 「带领史瑞克和他的伙伴们，体验电影之外的故事，踏上一段惊险刺激的四人小队动作冒险。穿行于史瑞克的沼泽等熟悉的地点，联手对付坏蛋，并利用每个角色的特殊能力解开谜题、完成任务目标。」

paragraphs.en: Pre-orders for players looking to get the jump on Shrek 2 Remastered are available now. IGN's team-up with Xbox for this year's fall presentation is finally here, so be sure to keep checking in for all of the latest updates. For more, you can see everything announced during the show's April installment .
paragraphs.cn: 想提前预订《怪物史瑞克2》重制版的玩家，现在已经可以预购。
